provenance.paper: Warnett & Zdun, Architectural Design Decisions for the Machine Learning Workflow, IEEE Computer 55(3), 2022; manuscript papers/spaces/COMSI-2021-07-0084.R2_Warnett.pdf
provenance.transcription: Decisions, options, forces and impacts of Table 2 (p. 5), which the paper calls the subset of ADDs it describes (p. 2). Read through the package's generated _generated/latex_files/overview_table.tex, the same table with forces numbered differently, mapped by name to Table 2's legend; spot-checked against the paper. Option descriptions are the model's option text (the paper describes options only in running prose). Decision links are not transcribed (no figure of them).
provenance.transcribed_by: Claude Code (implementer), 2026-10-03; no system output was open during transcription, but the transcriber had reviewed DelveDSpace C1 runs of 2026-10-02 earlier in the same session (see README)
